title: Configuration word contains its cell chunks
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $s\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $C$ be a configuration on input $x$. For every chunk index $j<2s+1$ and bit index $t<W(N)$, the bit of the configuration word at position $W(N)j+t$ equals bit $t$ of the encoding of the cell at index $j$ relative to shift $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols
